newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor, Zambia Konkola project.
newsitem.headline: Gencor, Zambia Konkola project.

text.p: Reuters inadvertently published a report on Wednesday concerning South African mining house Gencor Ltd and its involvement in a consortium planning to develop Zambia's Konkola Deep copper project.
The companies concerned declined to allow further details to be published until 2201 GMT.
The consortium comprises Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd's subsidiary Zambia Copper Investments Ltd (ZCI) (40 percent), Gencor Ltd (30 percent) and Falconbridge Ltd (30 percent).
Reuters apologises for any inconvenience caused.
